$comment: Ground truth for the ioredis pack (docs/packs.md, "Ground truth"). Each public repository is pinned at the commit before its own merged ioredis 5 to 6 upgrade. Expected findings come from two sources that are not Uptide, drafted by pnpm packs:truth on 2026-10-14 and read by hand before any pack test run: the repository's own TypeScript with ioredis 6.0.0 linked (no new diagnostic in any of the five), and the lines the upgrade changed for ioredis. Anchor rule, fixed before scoring and applied to every repository: one site per client construction the upgrade changed, at the first changed line of code of the run that contains it; a second construction in the same run starts its own site; edits that only serve that construction (a moved import, a widened constructor type) belong to it; pure insertions (an option added to an unchanged call), comments, and other packages' changes (@sentry/node, mermaid, vitest) are not sites. Unrelated packages bumped in the same commit or branch are not listed under `with`: they share no dependency edge with ioredis. RESEARCH.md has the evidence for each entry and the repositories screened out.
